Method of Attack: Deploys BlazeStealer malware to control the victim’s system and spy on them
Fetches a malicious script to enable a Discord bot
Retrieves and executes additional code from an external resource
Runs a Discord bot functioning as a backdoor
Steals system information, passwords, and files
Encrypts files and deactivates Windows Defender and Task Manager
Controls the computer’s camera to capture photos
Impacted Systems: Systems with developers working on obfuscation tools
Attack Vector: Malicious Python packages masquerading as obfuscators
